{{Quote|I won't be able to elude that KDY ship for very long, out there in the Oranessan system.|Dengar|<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>}}
The '''Oranessan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the planet [[Oran-µ]].

==History==
The [[KDY security cruiser]] tracked the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] to this system shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
